@tct.slider.minimumValue.description: Accessible name of the first (lower) thumb of a range Slider. It composes with the slider's label, which names the group. Example: `Price range, Minimum value`.

@tct.slider.maximumValue.description: Accessible name of the second (upper) thumb of a range Slider. It composes with the slider's label, which names the group. Example: `Price range, Maximum value`.
